## `neuro.object.isSealed`

Static method on `Object`.

> Returns true if existing property attributes cannot be modified in an object and new properties cannot be added to the object.

## Signatures

```ts
isSealed(input: { o: any; prompt?: string }): Promise<boolean>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Object.isSealed` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
